messages.text: do you guys ship to thailand?

Yes, we ship to Thailand, it falls under our Rest of World coverage. Shipping is calculated at checkout from your address. Prices are USD and don't include import VAT or duties, so anything customs raises on delivery is on the recipient, and we can't quote that figure for you.

One thing worth checking before you order: units ship with region-specific plugs and voltage. Tell me which miner you're looking at and I'll confirm what's available for you.
